The browser, categories, file list, generic import downloader and thumbnail URLs below are runtime calls. Platform packages/apps/cookbook/scripts and other packs contain no additional runtime caller for this surface. The six adoption apps have no Poly Haven demand.

backend.call: the asset browser lists a type's assets, narrowed to a category; the text filter and the paging are the editor's own, over the whole answer
an asset's files: each resolution's gltf with its includes (the .bin and the textures), each resolution's hdr and exr
the category picker: a type's categories, their names sorted
an import downloads the chosen file and each include to its relative path (a non-200 fails the import)

frontend.call: the browser shows each asset's thumbnail from the url the server builds (cdn.polyhaven.com/asset_img/thumbs/<id>.png?width=256)
